Blue Jackets: TV channel and streaming options for November 14
 By Data Skrive Nov. 14, 2026 11:49 am EST Updated Share article 
 The Columbus Blue Jackets (7-10) and the Philadelphia Flyers (5-10-6) take the ice on Nov. 14, 2026 at Nationwide Arena, starting at 7 p.m. ET on ESPN+. The Blue Jackets rank 16th and the Flyers 15th in the Eastern Conference.
 How to watch Philadelphia Flyers vs. Columbus Blue Jackets
 Venue: Nationwide Arena
 Time: 7 p.m. ET
 Streaming: ESPN+ (Sign in on ESPN+ with your Fubo account) 
 Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. 
 Philadelphia vs. Columbus odds
 Puck Line: Columbus -1.5 (+182), Philadelphia +1.5 (-230)
 Favorite Moneyline: Columbus -138
 Underdog Moneyline: Philadelphia +114
 Total: 5.5
 Total Over Odds: -120
 Total Under Odds: -103
 Injury reports
 Blue Jackets
 Isac Lundeström: Out (Achilles), 
 Conor Garland: Out (Upper Body), 
 Sean Monahan: Day-To-Day (Upper Body)
 Advertisement
 Flyers
 Noel Acciari: Day-To-Day (Upper Body), 
 Nikita Grebyonkin: Out (Upper Body)
 Stats to know
 Kent Johnson has put up 17 points in 17 games (eight goals and nine assists).
 Jet Greaves has conceded 29 goals (3.3 goals-against average) and racked up 215 saves with an .881 save percentage (41st in the league).
 Matvei Michkov has 10 goals and five assists for 15 total points this season.
 Daniel Vladar has 262 saves while allowing 36 goals (3.2 goals-against average) with an .879 save percentage (46th in the league).
